classification: Known R26/R27 misses motivate this new registered mechanism; not fresh generalization, safety or default selection.
baseline: R26 C3 on unchanged student my_torque; preserve the native output. Treat reported occupancy as a notification, not duration of external force.
mechanism: Independently estimate planar force from shared momentum residual and a continuous encoder/JTS nominal inverse. No injected-force, case ID, scheduled time, paired trace or actual physics contact is used by the detector. For each contiguous grip regime take an eight-sample causal average (two native four-sample decisions); current level and its eight-sample difference must BOTH exceed the normal signed bound in BOTH estimates and in BOTH closest normal kinematic regions. Fit only on the previous 27 force-free trajectories; use 15 different force-free ones to widen the bound; retain previous 15+18 unforced audits unused. Unknown/nonfinite regime adds nothing.
model: Partition each of 3 physically observed regimes (never gripped/currently gripped/actually released) into 12 normal pose-velocity medoids (two per joint, farthest-point coverage). Separate affine local wrench-level/change predictors in robustly scaled measured encoder/speed and known mass/first-moment; per-region normalized covariance ridge 0.01 times sample count, bias unpenalized. Bound each of 8 planar directions by maximum observed fit or calibration residual plus positive calibration excess above fit. Require both nearest regions within normal radius, independently certified. Use every eighth fit row for locating centers, all valid fit/cal rows for bounds. No fitted force-scale chosen from colliding trials.
notification: Start only after four contiguous out-of-envelope level AND change samples in aligned directions (within 45 degrees). Only one four-sample notice per inferred physical episode. Native C3 remains independent; an already native-supported excursion does not add a notice. Rearm only when neither observer pair backs the previous signed level, not by a time mask. A direction-specific different onset can be separated after a return to normal; never count a mere return from a force as a second impact.
tests: Matched no/first/second/both/long, authenticated native record and force/prefix equality on 3 disclosed R26 paired families x 3 mechanics; stock and transformed signed long singles; strict and during-force reported separately. Screen 33 additional unforced checks and previous cohort. No hard-held enrollment unless all R27 pre-enrollment requirements pass.
stop: Report each actual gain and each protected loss. Do not tune fitted coefficients on forced or reserved data. If broader floor fails keep independent 114 unopened. Never open old R28 G4 candidate rows.
